goal: calculate is given expressions of the form "1+1+...+1" (n ones, no spaces). What is the largest n for which it returns a value instead of raising expression_too_complex? Use CPython 3.11+ ast semantics.

ast.text: ast.parse("1+1", mode="eval") gives Expression(body=BinOp(left=Constant(1), op=Add(), right=Constant(1))). ast.walk yields every node reachable through fields, including operator nodes such as Add.
